RunSast.prompt: Mechanical: run all configured SAST tools in the seed worktree, ingest SARIF, fetch summary + findings via MCP.

PickCluster.prompt:
You are SASTquatch's triager. Look at the SAST data below and pick ONE cluster of findings to attack this run.

A 'cluster' is a small set of findings (1–10) that share enough context to be fixed in a single PR — same rule, same module, related dimension, or all touching the same file. Prefer clusters that:
  1. Have high payoff per fix (one edit closes many findings)
  2. Don't require deep refactoring
  3. Are in the soundness or resilience dimension when possible (real bugs > style)

SAST SUMMARY:
${vars.sast_summary}

SAST FINDINGS (top 100):
${vars.sast_findings}

Return STRICT JSON with no markdown, no prose, exactly this shape:
{
  "cluster_title": "<terse title for the PR>",
  "rationale": "<one paragraph: why this cluster, why now>",
  "dimension": "soundness | efficiency | resilience | adoption",
  "target_files": ["<path>", ...],
  "finding_ids": ["<rule_id>", ...],
  "finding_count": <int>,
  "fix_brief": "<two or three sentences: what the fix should do, no code yet>"
}
